name: Ali Yavar Jung National Institute of Speech and Hearing Disabilities
evidence: The official About the Institute page states that Ali Yavar Jung National Institute of Speech and Hearing Disabilities is an “autonomous organization” under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of India.
notes: The supplied ayjnihh.nic.in hostname did not resolve; the current official NIC site at ayjnishd.nic.in identifies the same institute and lists an ayjnihh.nic.in email address.
Normal TLS verification on the current official site returned a self-signed certificate-in-chain error, so curl --insecure was used for public GET requests as permitted.
